page.layout: One printed page (left page of the opening, the right side is the binding and blank). Running head at top; text in one column; a diagram of two triangles with lettered points set in the column between the text lines; a short heading CAPVT V. and a larger heading below it; then a paragraph beginning with a large initial; a catchword at the foot right.

main_text.p: stratio, cum tamen reuera eadem sit cum præcedenti, aut saltem facilime ex ea possit colligi: nam quia duo latera a.b. & a.c. sunt æqualia inter se, vtrique ex præcedenti etiam anguli h & k erunt inter se æquales. & quia ista latera a b & a c æqualibus lineis producuntur, vtriq; inter se erunt etiam æquales illi anguli, qui sunt infra basin, nempe l & m. Et annotandum est quod idem Clavius monet huius theorem. veritatem facile quoq; per ἐφαρμογήν, id est, per superpositionem & applicationem sensualem posse demonstrari, sint enim in triangulo a b c duo latera æqualia, nempe a b & a c, & ea producantur, vnum quidem ad d, alterum vero ad e. Dico tam angulos qui sunt supra basin h k quam angulos l m. qui sunt infra basin inter se esse æquales, si enim concipiamus mente triangulum a b c superponi alteri triangulo æquali a c b, ita vt recta a b rectæ linea a c superponatur, cadet punctum b in punctum c & punctum c in punctum b propter nim. laterum æqualitatem, atque ita recta & a b, cadet super rectam a c. in summa cadet recta super latus & basis cadet super basin: Vnde necessario concluditur angulum quoq; casurum super angulum (e.g.) angulum k casurum super angulum m. & angulum h super angulum n. angulum v. m. super angulum o. & angulum l. super angulum p. atque adeo angulos tam supra quam infra basin fore æquales, id quod demonstrasse oportuit.
main_text.head: CAPVT V.
De Quadrangulo, & Multangulo.
main_text.p: FVit triangulum: sequitur Quadrangulū: Est autem Quadrangulum figura siue superficies quæ terminatur 4. lineis rectis.

page.notes: The diagram shows two triangles with points a, b, c, d, e, h, k, l, m, n, o, p; it is not transcribed as text. The left margin and the right margin carry no printed notes. Some letters in the diagram and the text are faint; the word "Vnde" and the Greek word ἐφαρμογήν are read with some doubt. The heading "De Quadrangulo" is in italic display type with a long-s-like form, read as printed.
